map.眼压校正（角膜厚度校正） 使用指南: Intraocular Pressure Correction (Corneal Thickness Correction) User Guide
map.根据中央角膜厚度（CCT）对实测眼压进行估算校正，辅助青光眼风险评估。: Estimates and corrects the measured intraocular pressure from the central corneal thickness (CCT), supporting glaucoma risk assessment.
map.填写「中央角膜厚度 CCT（μm）」。: Enter the central corneal thickness CCT (um).
map.按中央角膜厚度 CCT 校正 Goldmann 眼压：corrected = I: Correct the Goldmann intraocular pressure by central corneal thickness CCT: corrected = IOP - ((CCT - 544)/10) x 0.7.
map.厚角膜者眼压被高估、薄角膜被低估的修正。: The correction for overestimated intraocular pressure in thick corneas and underestimated pressure in thin corneas.
map.：校正 = 18 − ((560−544)/10)×0.7 = 18 − 1.6: Correction = 18 - ((560 - 544)/10) x 0.7 = 18 - 1.6 x 0.7 = 18 - 1.12 = 16.88 mmHg (a thick cornea reads high, so the corrected value is lowered).
map.：校正 = 18 − ((500−544)/10)×0.7 = 18 + 3.0: Correction = 18 - ((500 - 544)/10) x 0.7 = 18 + 3.08 = 21.08 mmHg (a thin cornea reads low, so the corrected value is raised).
map.眼底(C/D比)与视神经评估器: Fundus (C/D Ratio) and Optic Nerve Evaluator
map.为何以 544μm 为基准？: Why use 544 um as the baseline?
map.544μm 约为人群平均 CCT，Goldmann 眼压标定为该厚度下的读数。: 544 um is about the population-average CCT, and the Goldmann tonometer reading is calibrated for readings at this thickness.
map.本式为简化近似；iop-correction 工具另给 Ehlers/Dough: This formula is a simplified approximation; the iop-correction tool also gives the mean of several formulas (Ehlers, Doughty, Feltgen).
